sourceNote: These paths are unchanged from source G a5027 to H5f; H only adds the previously reviewed no-thenable test comment. The subsequent cc389-to-f5ddb main delta does not touch the requested observer/channel/use-live-key/read-batch/rpc paths.
performed: Read exact current observer/channel/hook/native dispatch sources and relevant existing regression source.
Independent static reasoning only; no source edits, no new tests executed, no resources, no Actions originals or original acceptance JSON read, no ref update.
currentFacts: observeSWRRead records began before middleware hydration. staleOnFocus invokes only snapshotReadFetcher-registered fetchers inside the synchronous withDispatch token, after waitForCacheHydration.

Native callAction obtains capturePendingReadDispatch only for the five audited snapshot actions, before enqueueRead. This creates dispatchCaptured and a revocation promise, not pendingDispatchAt and not completed coverage.

MessageChannel drains the current turn once; flush partitions locale/workspace/isCurrent and existing generation. resetReadBatchScope rejects retired pending items. No response cache or added delay timer exists.

callRemoteAction awaits encodeArgs, checks current scope, captures the response dispatch proof, invokes onDispatch and immediately calls fetch(cache:no-store). No await separates these final steps. Therefore pendingDispatchAt is actual pre-fetch metadata, not queue-entry time.

The response object receives a WeakMap dispatch proof; batch projection copies it only to the five audited snapshot result types. observeListRead preserves it through one shallow wrapper. Multi-read or delta-merging syncCoordinatorChat, syncIssueList and syncThreadList are excluded.

readFresh joins an old-entry read only when pendingDispatchAt is later than after; completion must still show read.began advanced by the response proof, same current applied cache object, successful onSuccess and revision acceptance. A late completion alone is not accepted.

LiveChannel.onopen and live_ready are distinct. onopen queues unconditional catch-up with a new readBoundary; capability acknowledgement establishes coverageAfter. A late supported subscription uses max(coverageAfter, matching-kind invalidationAfter); unsupported/no-presence cases retain a fresh boundary. Newer pending obligations keep max(after).

All compared boundaries are monotonic same-renderer-realm order tokens, not wall clocks or Electron-main timestamps. A request actually dispatched after that renderer observes live_ready cannot have started its remote database snapshot before the dispatch, under the existing audited fresh-snapshot transport contract.

An onopen-derived obligation is an open-gap obligation; it must not be mislabeled capability-ready coverage. This design does not move either boundary or claim an unacknowledged kind is continuously covered.

admissibleTimeline: Q: exactly one audited snapshot enqueue/capture
L: existing freshness obligation, e.g. authorized capability-ready boundary
F: ordinary live flush calls readFresh while still queued
D: existing queue/encoding eventually reaches actual pre-fetch proof and onDispatch
C: exact resulting object commits through SWR
queueOnlyGap.currentBehavior: If R<=L, pendingDispatchAt is still absent at F, so readFresh immediately calls mutate. It does not mislabel the queue as sent, but it cannot join this genuinely not-yet-dispatched snapshot. This is a theoretical redundant-read window.
queueOnlyGap.candidateMinimalChange: Only widen readFresh's permission to wait, not its permission to return data: a latest nonreceived/nonsuperseded read with dispatchCaptured===true, dispatchNotified!==true, dispatchAmbiguous!==true and its existing pendingRevoked promise may await the original settled/revoked race. Do not set began or pendingDispatchAt at enqueue. Keep final proof/applied/revisions/current checks unchanged.
queueOnlyGap.reason: At F the audited send has not occurred; any subsequent real dispatch is later than L. Waiting does not itself certify completion. If no final dispatch proof arrives, use ordinary revalidation; original failures propagate; ambiguity or supersession wakes the existing revocation path.
queueOnlyGap.scope: No scheduler/timer/network/auth/cache lifetime change; no action added to the audited whitelist. This is a design proposal, not an implemented or tested patch.
queueOnlyGap.causalLimit: No exported receipt read in this review proves F occurred between Q and D in the failing run. It cannot be credited as eliminating any measured SQL, and cannot cover the principal Coordinator/Issue/Thread delta-reader excess.

sequence: W: external change commits before connection coverage
counterexamples.required: Catch-up must still issue a new authorized read. C>L is insufficient because S<L; the original cannot contain W.
D<P, so a later read remains required unless the already existing explicit revision-coverage contract proves it. Do not let the original pending hint erase P.
Retired lifetime must neither adopt old data nor start a departed-scope revalidation. Preserve current(), transport generation and exact owner/workspace result checks.

sequence: Q2: second capture or second dispatch from404 fallback
counterexamples.required: Ambiguous hint is revoked. Never certify a merged or fallback response by replacing its original identity with an enqueue timestamp.

minimumFalsificationMatrix: Force existing queued snapshot to remain un-dispatched through live flush, then release normal dispatch after L: new logic may wait but cannot report coverage before C; exactly one ordinary logical fetch may suffice only after valid proof and SWR commit.
Dispatch before L, hold response until after L: ordinary catch-up must still dispatch while old response is pending; final late completion must not suppress it.
Push/deadline after actual D and before C: preserve the newer after and trailing fresh read; multiple pre-D obligations may only join a dispatch later than their maximum boundary.
Queued read fails, becomes ambiguous, is superseded, or returns an unproven result: preserve original failure/no hidden retry, wake revocation, follow newer read or ordinary fallback.
Owner/workspace/cache retirement or hidden lifetime: no old-object adoption and no old-scope revalidation.

Retain existing single/batch post-ready cases, before-ready cases, two workspace array readers, 404 fallback revocation, comparator/discarded result and revision acceptance tests. The current pending-observer tests call notify before readFresh and do not directly cover F-before-D.
notAnAllowedShortcut: Do not replace dispatch/snapshot ordering with completion timestamps or requestedAt/render timestamps.
Do not delay onopen invalidation, increase the100ms flush/coalescing interval, disable fallback, or suppress legitimate push/deadline/visibility obligations.
Do not mark delta-merging readers snapshotReadFetcher or carry another read's proof without a separate full semantic audit.
Do not reuse an authorization SELECT after dispatch or across requests/executors/users/sessions/pins/principals/transactions/after scopes.

Do not preconnect an owner-home channel by guessing from selected workspace; ownerListWorkspace obtains an authorized owned home from a matching response, and the unresolved placeholder deliberately has null transport.
recommendation: No full Native441<=Web331 fix is justified by this static live audit alone. Keep the acceptance failed. The narrow queued-only design is falsifiable but needs actual occurrence/benefit evidence before attributing it to the failing budget. When initial HTTP is already before ticket/open, retain catch-up; a broader early-channel design needs a separately authorized scope source and must not delay the ordinary read.
